Hi Henrik,

The timeout you’re seeing is due to the size of the export—reports over 100 000 rows exceed the interactive limit. Please run the month‑end stock valuation report using the **“Execute in background”** option. Let me know if you need any help locating the spool list or scheduling the background run.
